title: A safe file reader
description:
Read a file of scores and deal with every problem.

```
scores.txt: 4 scores, average 80.25, 1 bad line (line 3: "ninety")
missing.txt: not found
```
hints: `try { ... } catch (NoSuchFileException e) { return path + ": not found"; } catch (IOException e) { ... }`: the more specific exception comes first (lesson 4.04).
`Integer.parseInt` throws `NumberFormatException` for a bad line; catch it inside the loop.
requirements: Write `scores.txt` first with `Files.write`, then read it with `Files.readAllLines`.
Bad lines are counted and do not stop the reading.
A missing file is caught as `NoSuchFileException`; other `IOException`s are reported with their message.
A custom checked exception `ScoreException` is thrown when every line is bad.
stretch: Use try-with-resources and `Files.newBufferedReader` so a huge file is never read into memory at once.
